retired.name: Rectangle Diagonal
retired.reason: Same Math.hypot(two sides) hypotenuse calculation; rectangle diagonal is exactly a right triangle hypotenuse.

retired.name: 3D Point Distance
retired.reason: General Euclidean distance accepts 3D point coordinates as two vectors and computes the same metric.

retired.name: Degrees to Radians
retired.reason: The publicly available Angle Converter already supports degrees to radians and other angle units.

retired.name: Radians to Degrees
retired.reason: The publicly available Angle Converter already supports radians to degrees and other angle units.

retired.name: Revenue Growth Between Periods
retired.reason: Growth percentage for two positive revenues is identical to the existing percentage-change calculation.

retired.name: 3D Vector Angle
retired.reason: 3D angle between two nonzero vectors is already computed by vector-angle-calculator, which supports any equal vector dimension from 2 through 100, including 3D and signed components.

latestAudit.summary: Removed five additional overlap utilities before first scheduled publication. Kept more general existing tools, preserved exact 10/week release cadence and no early publication.

semanticAudit.reviewMethod: Compared all catalog names, inspected 50 high-lexical-overlap pairs and algebraic formula groups across Wave 10 and Wave 11, then examined selected engine code, input domains and outputs. This is a targeted semantic audit, not a formal proof of uniqueness.
semanticAudit.note: Identical algebraic expressions across unrelated physical/business domains are not automatically equivalent features. Reversible transformations and different metrics also remain separate.
